test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Mid-Range Full Test - 02
subject: general
question:
This question is based on the following words.

(Left) TEN PAT SHE APE (Right)

How many letters are there between the second letter of the first word from the left and the second letter of the first word from the right, as per the English alphabetical order?
solution: Given: (Left) TEN PAT SHE APE (Right) According to the question: Second letter of the first word from the left → T__E__N → E
